title: ADR B01: Postgres over MySQL
author: Anika Rao
text:
# ADR B01: Postgres over MySQL
Date: 2025-01-16
Owner: Anika Rao
Status: Accepted

## Context
Dispatch needs tenant-scoped shipment transactions and the completed ledger needs reproducible reconciliation. The MySQL proof of concept needed application code for the reporting queries.

## Decision
Use PostgreSQL 16 as the transactional store for dispatch, booking and the completed shipment ledger. Use tenant_id in every tenant-owned key and query.

## Consequences
SQL migrations ship with the service. JSONB holds versioned partner attributes, not an excuse to omit schema validation. Linh owns read models; Platform owns transactional migrations.

## Review note
Keep this dated record when implementation changes. Link the replacement decision rather than silently editing the rationale.

title: ADR B02: Kafka carrier event log
author: Anika Rao
text:
# ADR B02: Kafka carrier event log
Date: 2025-01-23
Owner: Anika Rao
Status: Accepted

## Context
Carrier scans arrive late and out of order. Dispatch and analytics need independent consumers; a work queue that deletes each message on receipt cannot support both.

## Decision
Use Kafka for the durable carrier event log, partitioned by tenant and shipment. Consumers must tolerate at-least-once delivery and deduplicate by partner event ID.

## Consequences
Keep event occurrence time separate from ingestion sequence. Partition order is not a promise of carrier clock order. Poison events go to a dead-letter topic for investigation; replay needs a recorded reason.

## Review note
Keep this dated record when implementation changes. Link the replacement decision rather than silently editing the rationale.

title: ADR B03: One application monorepo

title: ADR B04: Tenant feature flags
author: Mei Tan
text:
# ADR B04: Tenant feature flags
Date: 2025-03-13
Owner: Mei Tan
Status: Accepted

## Context
A depot rehearsal should not enable an unfinished panel for every carrier. Branches that live for months are difficult to merge safely.

## Decision
Use Unleash for tenant-scoped feature flags. Every flag has an owner, a removal ticket and a safe default when the flag service is unavailable.

## Consequences
Flags do not bypass the release process. A production flag change is a configuration release. Never encode customer payloads in flag names or send them to the flag service.

title: ADR B05: Grafana Cloud telemetry
author: Mei Tan

# ADR B05: Grafana Cloud telemetry
Date: 2025-04-17
Owner: Mei Tan
Status: Accepted

## Context
Haruto can correlate dispatch queue age with rollout timestamps in the Grafana trial. Maintaining a separate search cluster would add another platform to operate.

## Decision
Send sanitized application metrics, logs and traces through OpenTelemetry to Grafana Cloud. Do not run an internal Elasticsearch cluster for application log search.

title: Architecture overview
author: Mei Tan
text:
# Architecture overview
Owner: Mei Tan. Reviewed 5 October 2026.

## Shipment path
1. Chen's carrier connectors poll partner APIs or receive webhooks, validate envelopes and append normalized events to Kafka.
2. The Python dispatch service consumes tenant and shipment partitions, applies deduplication, and writes shipment state and acknowledgements to PostgreSQL.
3. Route Lens reads the shipment timeline and arrival-confidence view through the API. Route Pilot is the earlier pilot name found in old screenshots and integration notes.
4. Depot scanners upload manifests and scan evidence through the same tenant boundary. Offline occurrence time is not ingestion order.

## Runtime boundaries
Application containers run on Google Kubernetes Engine. Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL holds transactional state; Cloud Storage holds regional attachments and recovery copies. Managed Kafka provides the event log. BigQuery holds approved analytics read models, not the dispatch source of truth.
Sakura payloads and backups stay in Japan. Singapore receives only aggregate counters without shipment identifiers. A region box on a diagram does not establish residency.

## Operation
GitHub Actions builds immutable images; Argo CD applies reviewed Kubernetes manifests. Grafana dashboards show queue age, ACK age and error rate beside the release SHA. Mei owns platform decisions, Chen owns Kestrel integration, and Haruto owns runtime response. See the dated ADRs for rationale rather than copying a configuration from a screenshot.

title: Tech stack
author: Mei Tan
text:
# Tech stack
Reviewed: 6 October 2026. Owner: Mei Tan.

## Languages and applications
- Python 3.12 and FastAPI: dispatch, booking API and carrier connectors. pytest covers contracts and replay cases.
- TypeScript, React and Vite: Route Lens browser interface. Playwright covers shipment navigation and depot filters.
- React Native and TypeScript: Android depot scanner client. SQLite persists offline uploads. ADR B08 replaces the older Cordova choice.
- Python and SQL: analytics transformations and evaluation notebooks. The serving configuration is owned in a separate decision record.

## Data and infrastructure
- PostgreSQL 16 on Cloud SQL: tenant-scoped shipment state, bookings and the completed ledger.
- Kafka: durable carrier events, independent consumer groups and dead-letter topics.
- Cloud Storage: attachments and recovery objects in each approved residency boundary.
- BigQuery: analytics read models. Redis: disposable request acceleration only, never the completed ledger.
- Google Cloud, GKE and container images in Artifact Registry: application runtime and image storage. Terraform in northwind-infra describes infrastructure.

## Delivery and visibility
GitHub hosts northwind-platform and northwind-infra. GitHub Actions runs checks and builds images. Argo CD applies approved manifests. Unleash controls tenant flags. OpenTelemetry feeds Grafana Cloud dashboards, sanitized logs and traces. No raw carrier body belongs in telemetry.
The normal production slots are Tuesday and Thursday mornings. A tool choice does not waive the Friday ban.

title: Engineering onboarding guide
author: Mei Tan
text:
# Engineering onboarding guide
Owner: Mei Tan. Current as of 7 October 2026.

## First morning
Ask Amina for the managed laptop handover. Enroll device management, enable disk encryption and register your hardware security key. Jiwon approves access through the access ticket. Use company SSO and individual accounts; production access is not part of laptop setup.

## Repositories and local development
1. Clone northwind-platform from the company GitHub organization. northwind-infra is separate and needs its own access review.
2. Install the repository-pinned Python 3.12, Node 22, pnpm and Docker versions.
3. Run docker compose up -d postgres kafka unleash from the repository root.
4. Run uv sync in services/dispatch, then uv run pytest. In web/, run pnpm install and pnpm dev.
5. Load the fabricated Osaka fixture, never a customer export. Ask Chen for the captured Kestrel fixtures. Local connector tests must not poll the partner.

## First release
Open a PR with tests and a rollback plan. Kavya reviews the smoke evidence; an owner approves contract changes. GitHub Actions builds the image; put the SHA, smoke link and rollback reference on the ticket before Argo CD promotion.
Use Tuesday or Thursday morning production slots. No production deploys on Fridays, including scheduled jobs and configuration-only releases. Emergency mitigation requires incident commander approval and two responders. Mei owns the rule. The old Release process wiki's Friday window is stale.

## First on-call shift
Shadow Haruto before joining the rota. Watch dispatch ACK age, not only healthy pods. Page the incident commander for priority-one incidents, then notify customer success. Never replay a tenant's events without checking scope and recording the reason.

title: Product overview
author: Aisha Rahman
text:
# Product overview
Owner: Aisha Rahman. Reviewed 6 October 2026.

## What we build
Northwind Labs makes logistics software for teams coordinating carriers and depots. Route Lens gives dispatchers a shipment timeline, delayed-shipment view and arrival-confidence range. The dispatch service and carrier connectors keep acknowledgements and scan history aligned.
Route Pilot is the earlier pilot name. Old decks use it as a headline; new campaign headlines use Route Lens. Do not promise a second standalone paid product from an old Route Pilot screenshot.

## Customer workflows
Meridian's dispatchers reconcile carrier scans against completed shipments. Sakura's depot supervisors use translated training and warehouse scanner flows. Their payloads and backups stay in Japan. Kestrel is an integration partner, not a Northwind product.

## Commercial basics
Route Lens costs USD 149 per workspace per month for new subscriptions. Signed pilot order forms keep the USD 99 rate for six months; that is not a public offer. The second inference pass raises cost, which explains the reset. SAML SSO is included in Enterprise, not a paid add-on. Bill once per completed shipment, not per tracking event; exclude cancellations from the completed ledger.
The GA plan moves from 15 April to 2 June 2026 because the three-week accuracy gate is not met. An old enablement email does not override the replan. Nur owns pricing evidence; Aisha owns product scope.

title: Glossary
author: Thao Tran
text:
# Glossary
Maintainer: Thao Tran. Reviewed 7 October 2026.

## Product and operations
- Route Lens: the current public product name for shipment visibility and dispatch workflow.
- Route Pilot: the earlier pilot name retained in historical material.
- Carrier: the organization moving a shipment and publishing tracking events.
- Depot: the physical operating location where staff scan, load and hand off shipments.
- Kestrel: a carrier integration with tenant-scoped polling and cursor recovery.
- ACK: acknowledgement that dispatch accepts or records work. ACK age measures outstanding work, not pod uptime.
- Completed ledger: the reconciled shipment record Finance uses for billing, excluding cancellations.

## Technical terms
- Occurrence time: when the carrier says a scan happened.
- Ingestion sequence: the ordering assigned when we accept events. It is distinct from occurrence time and is used for tracking cursors.
- Dead-letter topic: events held for investigation after processing fails. It is not a permission to replay everything.
- Idempotency token: the client's identifier for one booking attempt across retries, scoped to its tenant.
- Manifest: a versioned scanner handoff document. A new server writer does not mean every warehouse reader updates immediately.
- Feature flag: a tenant-scoped switch with an owner and safe default. Production changes still follow the release rule.
- Confidence range: the arrival estimate shown to users. Do not replace it with a precise minute in copied sales material.

Page comment, Yuki Mori: Please keep ACK expanded in the workshop handout. Depot supervisors read acknowledgement more easily than our dashboard shorthand.

title: Security and access policy
author: Jiwon Park
text:
# Security and access policy
Owner: Jiwon Park. Reviewed 8 October 2026.

## Accounts and devices
Use individual SSO accounts with a hardware security key on managed, encrypted laptops. Request access with a named owner, business purpose and expiry. A GitHub membership is not approval to read production shipments. Store service credentials in the approved secret store, never in code, screenshots or chat.

## Customer information
Keep Sakura customer payloads and backups in Japan. Aggregate counters without shipment identifiers may go to Singapore. Do not put raw carrier payloads in application logs. Use event IDs and trace IDs for investigation; collect customer evidence through the restricted ticket path.

## Temporary access
Vendor troubleshooting access expires after 30 minutes and requires a named internal sponsor. This is separate from the support break-glass grant. Use the current Support session review, March record for support session duration; do not copy the older Support access handbook.
Record approval and closure in the ticket. Jiwon owns policy exceptions; an engineer cannot extend a vendor session by keeping a tab open.

## Review
For a new subprocessor, Nandini coordinates the standard DPA notice before customer use. Screenshots in a rehearsal must use fabricated tenant data. No access value belongs in this page.

title: On-call runbook
author: Haruto Sato
text:
# On-call runbook
Owner: Haruto Sato. Reviewed 8 October 2026.

## Triage
1. For a priority-one support incident, page the incident commander immediately, then notify customer success. Do not wait for the customer success inbox to route it.
2. Inspect dispatch ACK age, consumer lag and tenant splits alongside the last release SHA. Healthy pods alone do not show dispatch recovery.
3. Record event IDs, affected tenants and known symptoms. Keep payload bodies out of logs and chat.
4. Siti coordinates the first customer notice within 30 minutes of confirmation for severity one. State that the cause is unknown when it is unknown. Enterprise priority-one tickets need acknowledgement within 15 minutes, including weekends.

## Mitigation
Compare the previous image and configuration with the current rollout. Put the rollback reference in the incident thread and verify that ACK age falls after recovery. Kestrel polling is limited to two requests per tenant under the v3 agreement; cursor persistence is unchanged.
No production deploys on Fridays, including scheduled jobs and configuration-only releases. Emergency mitigation requires incident commander approval and two responders. Routine image housekeeping is not an emergency.

## Handoff
Leave a timeline, owner and next observation. Haruto handles runtime response; Chen handles partner integration; Mei owns platform decisions. Siti owns customer communication. Refer to the current dated retry and access decisions before operating their controls.

# Benefits FAQ

## Where do I find my benefits enrollment?
Use the People portal linked from your onboarding ticket. Amina sends the enrollment checklist to your individual company account. The policy schedule in that portal lists the cover applicable to your employment location; do not infer your cover from another colleague's screenshot.

## Can I replace a broken laptop accessory?
Yes. Ask People Operations for a replacement request and attach the device asset number. Keep the receipt and manager approval in the request. Do not send bank details or home addresses to a public channel.

Send your manager the course title, work relevance and price before purchasing. People Operations records the approval and Finance processes the receipt. An approval for one course does not create a recurring subscription approval.

Contact Amina through the restricted People ticket queue. Do not attach medical documents to Slack. Amina can explain the insurer's enrollment steps and direct personal eligibility questions to the provider.

Send both dated links to Amina. She confirms the applicable document before you make a purchase. This FAQ is a routing guide and does not replace the location-specific schedules.

title: Local development troubleshooting
author: Pranav Menon
text:
# Local development troubleshooting
Owner: Pranav Menon. Reviewed 29 September 2026.

## Dispatch starts but shows no shipments
Check that the Compose Kafka broker and Postgres container are healthy. Run the fabricated Osaka import from the local fixture task, then inspect consumer group lag. The web app tenant picker must match the fixture tenant. Do not use a production export to make an empty screen look realistic.

## Schema mismatch
Run the repository migration task against your local database. Check your branch's packages/contracts version before regenerating clients. Keep the previous manifest fixture in tests; regenerating every fixture from the newest writer deletes compatibility coverage.

## Partner connection errors
Use recorded Kestrel responses locally. The fixture contains invented event IDs and cannot authorize a partner request. Chen owns connector contract questions. Please attach the failing fixture name rather than a real customer body to a PR.

Page comments
Kavya Iyer: The clock in the retry test is frozen. A failing boundary assertion is not fixed by sleeping for another second.
Pranav Menon: Added that note beside the test command. Also check UTC versus the depot local date.

title: Carrier connector field guide
author: Chen Wei
text:
# Carrier connector field guide
Owner: Chen Wei. Reviewed 30 September 2026.

## Boundaries
A connector normalizes a partner envelope, preserves its event identifier and writes to Kafka. Dispatch owns shipment state. Do not let a connector write an ad hoc correction directly into the completed ledger.

## Kestrel
The accepted v3 contract limits polling to two requests per tenant, replacing the old four-slot agreement. Larger pages compensate for lower concurrency. Cursor persistence stays unchanged. Treat response header names case-insensitively; the staging gateway uses different casing.
Tracking cursors use ingestion sequence. A late carrier scan may have an earlier occurrence time, so occurrence time alone is not a reliable checkpoint.

## Before replay
Check the tenant, saved cursor and current credential validity using the restricted operations tool. Record the event IDs and the reason. A partner status page can be green while our tenant has a credential failure. For a failed fixture, leave the original capture beside the new example.

Page comment, Kavya Iyer: Include the larger-page fixture when changing v3 parsing. Request count alone made the first capacity graph look worse than the delivered event count.

title: Data store ownership map
author: Linh Nguyen
text:
# Data store ownership map
Owner: Linh Nguyen. Reviewed 30 September 2026.

## Transactional and analytical stores
- PostgreSQL: Platform owns shipment writes, booking transactions and schema migrations. Finance reconciles completed shipments through the approved ledger view.
- Kafka: Platform owns broker operation; Chen owns connector envelopes; each consumer owner tracks offsets and deduplication.
- BigQuery: Data owns approved read models and dashboard definitions. A warehouse count is not a production correction.
- Cloud Storage: object owners specify region and access scope. Sakura payloads and recovery copies remain in Japan.
- Redis: disposable acceleration, not authoritative billing or shipment history.

## Handoffs
A schema PR needs a contract fixture and the migration rollback path. Ask Linh about dashboard semantics and Mei about production state. Do not derive an active-workspace definition from a login graph; consult the current dated Data agreement.

Page comment, Nur Aziz: The invoice unit is a completed shipment, excluding cancellations. Ten carrier scans do not create ten billable shipments.
Linh Nguyen: Kept that warning beside the ledger arrow in the training diagram.

title: Build and release checklist
author: Kavya Iyer
text:
# Build and release checklist
Owner: Kavya Iyer. Reviewed 1 October 2026.

## Pull request
- Explain the tenant impact and include the failing fixture for a bug.
- Run Python tests for affected services and TypeScript checks for affected clients.
- Run shared contract checks for manifests and connector envelopes.
- Keep customer evidence in the restricted ticket; PR fixtures use fabricated data.

## Promotion
GitHub Actions builds an immutable image tagged with the commit SHA. Argo CD promotes the reviewed manifest. Record the SHA, smoke link, rollback reference and release buddy before promotion. Haruto watches ACK age and consumer lag, not just container readiness.
Normal production release slots are Tuesday and Thursday mornings. No Friday production deploys, including scheduled jobs and configuration-only releases. Emergency mitigation requires incident commander approval and two responders. A production feature flag or dispatch setting change is configuration, even when it needs no image build.

## Closeout
Verify the affected tenant workflow and leave the observed result in the ticket. A screenshot of a green build does not show customer recovery. Keep the prior release reference until the release owner closes the ticket.

title: Telemetry field guide
author: Haruto Sato
text:
# Telemetry field guide
Owner: Haruto Sato. Reviewed 1 October 2026.

## Start with a question
For a dispatch incident, compare oldest outstanding acknowledgement, consumer lag and errors by tenant against the last release time. For a connector failure, inspect response class and event ID. A single combined tenant graph can hide the scope.

## Tools
OpenTelemetry instruments Python services and propagates trace context through Kafka headers. Grafana Cloud holds sanitized logs, traces and metrics. Dashboard links live in the on-call index. The deployment annotation uses the image SHA from GitHub Actions.

## Safe evidence
Do not serialize complete carrier JSON into application logs. Use opaque event references and trace IDs. Addresses, credentials and shipment payload bodies belong outside telemetry. Do not add a shipment ID as a metric label to make one investigation easier; it creates unnecessary cardinality and exposure.

## Reading the charts
Queue age is different from queue length. An idle tenant can have a small queue and a very old unacknowledged event. Note the graph timezone in the incident timeline. Leave the original graph interval beside an annotated screenshot so a later reader can check the conclusion.

title: Stack walkthrough for Support
author: Siti Nuraini
text:
Stack walkthrough for Support
9 October 2026. Notes by Siti Nuraini.

00:00 Siti Nuraini: Customers say Route Lens is stale. Which part of the stack should Support name in the escalation?
00:31 Haruto Sato: Start with symptoms and tenant scope. The React browser reads the Python API; dispatch consumes Kafka and writes Postgres. It is possible for the web page to load while acknowledgements stop progressing.
01:08 Chen Wei: Kestrel polling has its own response and cursor evidence. We use two concurrent requests per tenant now. The old setup page still shows four.
01:49 Daniel Lim: I can collect an event ID through the ticket. I will not ask a depot supervisor to paste a shipment body in chat.
02:17 Siti Nuraini: Good. For priority one, page the incident commander immediately, then notify customer success. Acknowledge Enterprise priority-one tickets within 15 minutes, weekends included.
02:50 Haruto Sato: The on-call index links Grafana. A screenshot of a green pod misses queue age, so keep the time interval and the last release SHA in the handoff.
03:22 Siti Nuraini: I will use this with the fabricated Osaka tenant in training.
